readings.text: pizza delivery guy sprints down a busy street nonstop, i swerve left and right around taxis, leap over trash cans and grab tips till i reach the last house
a cat knocks yarn balls into a basket, two matching ones squish together into a bigger ball, keep the heap from reaching the top
1v1 vs a giant yeti in the snow, wait for him to raise his fists, roll away, then punch him back
a ghost hunter creeps through the graveyard relighting every candle on the tombstones while a zombie shuffles after her
move a shopping basket under the shelves as groceries tumble down, keep the apples and avoid the rotten eggs
burger patties swing back n forth over the bun, let each one go at the perfect moment so it sits right on the last one, how tall can u get it
a goose in the city shuffles one square at a time across honking traffic, a river of drifting logs and a railway to get home
a grumpy farmer stands in his field blasting swarms of crows with a water hose before they get to the corn
my hamster scurries around the living room rug while the cat keeps hunting him, stay alive as long as u can and nab sunflower seeds
a lumberjack hacks apart logs that get hurled up out of the forest, careful not to hit the beehives
guide a wobbly moon lander down onto the flat pad with little puffs from its engine and dont smash the legs
a dj cat slaps the right button every time a glowing arrow slides down to the bottom, all perfectly in sync with the song
shoulder-barge the other bumper bots off the round stage in the factory before they knock you off
help a little frog spring between rocks bobbing on lava, one bad leap and he's toast, get him up to the crater rim
a beaver guards its dam by setting pinecone launchers on each forest path so the termite army never reaches it
a chubby pigeon wobbles forward through the city on its own, every click bumps it up a bit so it slips between pairs of pipes
smack the zombies rising out of their graves for a split second before they sink back down, leave the friendly ghosts alone
a skeleton bowls his own skull through the air across the graveyard trying to knock over a tower of pumpkins
grow your army by picking the right portals, x3 good, -20 bad, then send everyone at the enormous king at the end
grandma at her stove flipping pancakes, frying eggs and pouring coffee as the breakfast orders get crazier and crazier
a safecracker watches the needle zip back and forth across the dial and has to freeze it right on the tiny green notch
you sprint down a frozen mountain road on autopilot, shift sideways past snowmen, vault fallen trees and crouch under branches, grab hot cocoa cups along the way
a surfing otter zooms out at sea against three dolphins, weave around the buoys and be the first one to the pier
plop planets into a bowl, two of the same kind smoosh into a bigger planet, dont let them spill over the rim
a kid with a bucket at the foot of a volcano gathering gemstones that rain down while staying away from the lava rocks
a boxing kangaroo trades blows with one crocodile in the desert, weaving out of his chomps and countering every time
a raccoon roams the supermarket after closing time scooping up every snack that fell on the floor till the place is spotless
inch your way across the jungle, a road of charging rhinos, then a river where you ride drifting crocodiles, then the rail line
a sushi chef slashes the fish flung into the air with his knife but leaves the spiky sea mines alone
tiny knight bounds from one floating stone to the next over bottomless drops to reach the throne room at the top of the castle
a mall cop swats shoplifters who peek out from behind clothing racks for a moment, but the real shoppers dont get hit
im stuck behind a submarine porthole zapping swarm after swarm of angry jellyfish drifting at me
a desert lizard stretches a cactus stick longer and longer, then tips it over to reach the next rock tower, too short or too long and he falls
keep the zombie horde from shambling down the five hallways into my mall food court, put a guard in each hallway
keep yourself airborne in a spooky cave, each click is one wingbeat up, thread between the stalactites and stalagmites
a breakdancing robot in the factory hits its four foot pads in sync with the techno song whenever the glowing arrows scroll up to the top
a chubby walrus bumps other walruses off a round chunk of ice floating in the ocean without slipping off himself
a gorilla lobs coconuts into a tiny basket across the jungle river, hold longer to fling harder and aim the curve right
sneak around the factory floor patching every leaky pipe one by one while a security robot patrols after you
one tiny lemming dashes down a cave tunnel, go through the right doors to turn him into 10, 50, 200 lemmings, avoid the saws, then swarm the huge troll at the end
a rescue helicopter has to ease down gently onto a tiny rooftop pad on a mountain hut in a snowstorm without crashing
a pirate crab brawls on the sand, pinching every seagull in the area until none of them can get up
my corgi dashes through a desert canyon all by itself, i switch between three paths so it misses the cactuses, springs over rocks and slides under low arches, snagging bones
a monkey dangles coconuts from a swaying vine and lets go at just the right second so each one lands on the heap, see how close to the canopy it gets
a hedgehog scurries forward bit by bit across forest roads full of logging trucks and a stream with floating leaves to stand on
an octopus drops shells into a giant clam, two same shells mash into a bigger shell until the clam is too full
a penguin scoots side to side under a snowy sky snagging the fish that fall and steering clear of icicles
a samurai rooster takes on one rival rooster in the barnyard, sidestep his big swing then strike while hes wide open
a blacksmith stuck at his anvil in the castle hammering swords and mending shields for knights before the queue gets too long
a snowman plants himself on a hill and fires his snowball blaster at the evil penguins charging up at him
slash watermelons and coconuts as they get launched over the beach, just dont cut the dynamite
go left and right through a dark cave and leap across the chasms between rocky shelves until u find the exit door
a grumpy gardener with a rolling pin smacks the gophers that peek out of the flowerbeds for a sec, but never the bunnies
a pufferfish swims ahead nonstop and every press makes it puff upward so it can sneak between spiky coral spires
a wizard protects the castle gate as skeleton soldiers trudge up four roads, cast spells on each road before they get there
i chuck a baseball at a pyramid of tin cans on the boardwalk, power it up and aim the curve to knock em all down
play bongos on the beach at sunset, smack the left or right drum exactly when the seashells scrolling down reach the sand, keep up with the song
steer a parrot through the jungle vines against a flock of rival birds, loop through the flower hoops and beat them all to the big tree
a few rubber ducks float down a factory conveyor, every right sign doubles them, then they bury the boss robot at the end
a grumpy rhino butts mountain goats off a round rock above the lava before they bump him in
a chicken needs to catch the bus, so get it across six busy roads and a river of bobbing logs one step at a time
a pizza chef slices pizzas in a math puzzle, figure out where to cut so every guest gets the exact same amount
a seal shoots hoops on an iceberg, hold to power up and lob the beach ball in a curve into the net
my fox runs left and right and springs from treetop to treetop over gaps to reach his den in the woods
a card battle where my wizard plays spell cards against a dragon's deck, taking turns
a samurai cat faces a single ninja dog, sidestep his big slash and slice him back while he's open
defend your burger stand from the lunch rush: grill patties, add cheese and bag orders before customers get mad
dating sim where you go out with members of a rock band and pick what to say to win the drummer's heart
an opera singer has to hit the high note perfectly, a pointer whizzes along a bar and you stop it in the tiny gold zone
a frog in the meadow collects raindrops in a leaf, sliding side to side as they fall but avoiding the hailstones
escape room where a detective searches a haunted mansion for clues and solves riddles to unlock the front door
a cheetah races down a dusty desert trail by itself, i just shift left or right to miss boulders and spring over fallen trees grabbing water bottles
a tiny penguin slides down an icy slope combining with every penguin group it passes through the right doors till its an army, then they dogpile a huge walrus
a story about a turtle who enters a race against a hare in the meadow and you choose what he says at every stop
a bulldog fights three other dogs on a round floating raft out at sea, bump them into the water without falling in
run a medieval castle, build farms, collect taxes and decide which lords to trust before the enemy kingdom invades next winter
a baby dragon beats its wings to stay up and has to touch down softly on top of the castle tower without crashing
my grandpa sits by the frozen lake waiting for a bite, then you reel the fish in slowly so the line doesnt snap
build the tallest tower of jelly blobs in a jar, drop them in and matching blobs blend into a bigger blob, game over if it reaches the lid
shoot pics of wild animals on a jungle safari, sharper photos get more points and fill up your album
